items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Mr. Bass and Charlotta Bass in the context of publishing the California News/Eagle, but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not respond with any personal connection or relationship to them.

ctx.x: Yes, it did. Not right away, not right away. There was something in here about that. Oh, I guess it was in a --
It's a story on the front page. You said this paper, the California News, was published by Mr. Bass, --
